yaml:
title: Semantic 01 - Exact Field Match
id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
status: test
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image: 'C:\Windows\System32\whoami.exe'
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
  condition: selection

cases.expected_reason: Both Image and User exactly match selection values.
Sigma default string equality is case-insensitive.
Exact match must not match superstring with extra suffix.
Boundary: process_termination (activity_id=2) must not match process_creation (activity_id=1).

Boundary: '%' and '_' in Sigma string are literal characters, not SQL LIKE wildcards.

dimension_name: Regular Expression (re, i, m, inline flags)
yaml:
title: Semantic 05 - Regex Case Sensitivity and Multiline Flags
id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000005

  product: windows
detection:
  sel_strict:
    CommandLine|re: 'Invoke-[A-Z][a-z]+Mimikatz'
  sel_multiline_inline_i:
    CommandLine|re|m: '(?i)^net\s+localgroup\s+administrators'
  condition: 1 of sel_*

cases.expected_reason: Matches case-sensitive regex 'Invoke-[A-Z][a-z]+Mimikatz'.
Sigma |re without |i is case-sensitive per Sigma specification.

process.cmd_line:
echo start
NET  LOCALGROUP  Administrators /add bob

cases.expected_reason: Boundary: |re|m combined with inline (?i) matches start of second line case-insensitively.
Anchored ^ must not match when preceded by 'echo ' on same line.

dimension_name: Boolean NOT & SQL Three-Valued Logic Safety

id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000009
status: test

  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  exclusion:
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'legit_updater.dll'
  condition: selection and not exclusion

cases.expected_reason: rundll32.exe with non-excluded ParentCommandLine must match.
Boundary (3VL): when ParentCommandLine is absent, exclusion is False, so 'not exclusion' MUST be True.
Boundary (3VL): when ParentCommandLine is JSON null, exclusion is False, so 'not exclusion' MUST be True.
ParentCommandLine matches exclusion, so 'not exclusion' is False.

yaml:
title: Semantic 13 - Plain, Base64 (Uncased Default), and Explicit Cased Modifiers
id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000013
status: test
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel_plain:
    User: 'CORP\SecAdmin'
  sel_cased:
    CommandLine|cased|contains: 'SeDebugPrivilege'
  sel_b64_default:
    CommandLine|base64|contains: 'IEX'
  sel_b64_cased:
    ParentCommandLine|base64|cased|contains: 'IEX'
  condition: 1 of sel_*

cases.expected_reason: Sigma Spec v2.1.0: plain string matching without |cased is case-insensitive by default.
Sigma Spec v2.1.0: exact case 'SeDebugPrivilege' matches |cased|contains.
Sigma Spec v2.1.0: lowercase 'sedebugprivilege' must not match explicit |cased|contains.
'SUVY' is Base64('IEX') and matches CommandLine|base64|contains: 'IEX'.
Sigma Modifiers Spec v2.1.0 & pySigma v1.5.1 (SigmaBase64Modifier -> SigmaString): |base64 transforms 'IEX' -> 'SUVY' without implying |cased, so default case-insensitive matching matches 'suvy99'.
pySigma v1.5.1: |base64|cased|contains produces SigmaCasedString('SUVY'), matching exact uppercase 'SUVY'.
pySigma v1.5.1: explicit |base64|cased|contains enforces case-sensitive matching and rejects lowercase 'suvy'.

dimension_name: Unicode, Backslashes, Windash & SQL Injection Safety

title: Semantic 14 - Unicode Paths, Windash Variants, and SQLi Literal Safety
id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000014

  sel_sqli_literal:

cases.expected_reason: Matches UTF-8 CJK characters, backslashes, and literal underscore.
|windash matches Windows '/' flag prefix variant.
Boundary: |windash matches Unicode en-dash (U+2013) flag obfuscation.
SQLi safety: "' OR '1'='1" in rule is bound as a parameter and must NOT tautologically match benign events.

dimension_name: Array Fields (OCSF v1.4.0 DNS answers[].rdata Object Array)
yaml:
title: Semantic 15 - OCSF DNS answers[].rdata Object Array Matching
id: 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000015
status: test
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  sel_exact:
    answers: '198.51.100.77'
  sel_contains:
    QueryResults|contains: 'IEX ('
  filter_sinkhole:
    answers: '0.0.0.0'
  condition: (sel_exact or sel_contains) and not filter_sinkhole

cases.expected_reason: Second dns_answer object has rdata == '198.51.100.77' and no element matches filter_sinkhole ('0.0.0.0').
dns_answer.rdata contains 'IEX (' via QueryResults -> answers.rdata.
Second element rdata=='0.0.0.0' triggers filter_sinkhole, so 'not filter_sinkhole' excludes the event.
OCSF v1.4.0 dns_answer isolation: target strings appear ONLY in sibling attributes (class, type, flags), NOT in rdata ('v=spf1 -all').
Empty answers array [] has zero dns_answer elements and must not match.
Missing answers field in DNS Query event must evaluate cleanly to NO_MATCH.
